display_name: Cakebread Cellars Cuttings Wharf Chardonnay, Los Carneros
raw_content:
{
  "hook": "Cuttings Wharf Vineyard in Los Carneros supplies Cakebread's Chardonnay from vines rooted in Haire clay soils that retain moisture amid constant bay winds. Those conditions yield green apple and citrus flavors with a saline edge you taste directly from the fog-drenched site. This bottling stands out for balancing Carneros tension against subtle oak layering.",
  "wine_summary": "Cakebread Cellars farms Cuttings Wharf as estate fruit in Los Carneros, where the AVA's 37,000 acres straddle Napa and Sonoma for shared maritime cooling. The winery, Napa pioneers since 1973, prioritizes sustainable viticulture on their properties, letting Carneros terroir drive Chardonnay with bright fruit over heavy oak dominance. Heavy clay loams force vine struggle, concentrating flavors that define this wine's profile amid the region's diurnal swings of 50°F.",
  "terroir_expression": "Haire and Diablo clay series soils, derived from sedimentary bedrock, hold water through Carneros's windy, foggy summers from San Pablo Bay, stressing vines for smaller berries packed with green apple and lemon zest. Flat-to-rolling hills expose clusters to cool Pacific air, preserving acidity and adding mineral salinity that cuts through the palate. Diurnal shifts amplify those traits, turning site specifics into a tense, refreshing sip.",
  "vinification_summary": "Whole-cluster pressing captures delicate aromatics before barrel fermentation in mostly neutral French oak, with full malolactic fermentation converting sharp malic acid to creamy lactic for texture without excess butter. Sur lie aging on yeast lees builds mouthfeel while stirring integrates oak spice. These steps preserve Carneros freshness, avoiding the ripe tropical notes of warmer Napa sites.",
  "food_pairing": "Dungeness crab cakes — the wine's salinity and citrus match the sweet crab and briny crustacean edge. Nashville hot chicken — acidity slices through spice and fat, while apple notes temper heat. Roast chicken with herb stuffing — subtle oak echoes poultry savoriness, acidity refreshes white meat. Seared scallops with beurre blanc — creamy lees texture mirrors sauce richness, minerality cleanses. Whole baked branzino with lemon — bright acids enhance flaky fish without overpowering.",
  "comparable_wines": "Ramey Rochioli Vineyard Chardonnay — shares Carneros-adjacent cool climate for apple-mineral drive and balanced oak. Artesa Carneros Chardonnay — matching clay soils yield similar tension and citrus focus at estate scale. Flowers Camp Meeting Ridge Chardonnay — Sonoma Coast winds mimic bay fog for vibrant acidity and site-driven restraint.",
  "style_profile": "Medium-bodied dry Chardonnay with bright acidity and subtle lees creaminess",
  "cellar_recommendation": "Drink within 3-7 years from vintage for peak fruit-acid harmony. Store at 55°F away from light and vibration.",
  "value_assessment": "$39-$50 covers recent vintages at retail. Stacks against Merryvale Carneros Chardonnay or Gundlach Bundschu Carneros at the same price with tighter site focus from estate clay. Worth buying for reliable Carneros purity without Napa markup.",
  "market_position": "Restaurants in Napa and San Francisco feature it on California white lists for by-the-glass pours. Retail buyers seeking approachable Chardonnay stock it for everyday dinner tables. Collectors skip it, favoring Cakebread's Reserve for aging.",
  "insider_take": "Skip this if chasing butterbomb Chardonnay — Carneros winds demand leaner styles that prioritize site snap over plushness. Buyers overlook how clay retention builds mid-palate density missing in flimsier Sonoma Coast versions. Grab 2021 or 2023 for the best bay-driven value.",

parsed.wine_summary: Cakebread Cellars farms Cuttings Wharf as estate fruit in Los Carneros, where the AVA's 37,000 acres straddle Napa and Sonoma for shared maritime cooling. parsed.terroir_expression: Haire and Diablo clay series soils, derived from sedimentary bedrock, hold water through Carneros's windy, foggy summers from San Pablo Bay, stressing vines for smaller berries packed with green apple and lemon zest. Diurnal shifts amplify those traits, turning site specifics into a tense, refreshing sip.
parsed.vinification_summary: Whole-cluster pressing captures delicate aromatics before barrel fermentation in mostly neutral French oak, with full malolactic fermentation converting sharp malic acid to creamy lactic for texture without excess butter. Sur lie aging on yeast lees builds mouthfeel while stirring integrates oak spice. These steps preserve Carneros freshness, avoiding the ripe tropical notes of warmer Napa sites.
